page.layout: Two columns of a printed table of contents, with braces grouping entries; left column carries the main lines with margin numbers at its left edge, and the right column, partly cut off, sits at the right of the left column. Running head at top, page number at top right.; One column of entries in the centre-right, with a brace grouping the Therme entries; below the column, at left, a short block of two lines; at lower right one line, "Balnea".

main_text.head: Templa quatuor.
main_text.l: Martis Extramurani. Victor & Rufus, qui Aedem nominat.
main_text.head: Aedes Sex.
main_text.l: Martis Quirini. Victor. Rufus simpliciter Martis appellat.
Camaenarum. Victor Plinius lib. xxxiv. cap. v in Aede hac ponit Statuam Attij Poëtae.
main_text.head: Area Septem:
main_text.l: Thalli, sive Galli, sive Gallię (variant enim Libri) Victor, Rufus.
main_text.head: Area Duae.
main_text.p: Lapis Manalis Festus lib.xi. & lib. i: in Aquelicium, Labeo apud Fulgentium Placiadem in Manales, M. Varro apud Nonium in Trulleum; cuius Verba corruptiora emendat ingeniose Josephus Scaliger ad Festi illud, Manalem Lapidem. Designat hunc Lapidem. Martialis libro iii Epigr.xviii.

Porticus Vipsani. Enumerat hanc Porticum inter Prime Regionis Loca Martialis iiii Epig.xviii. Idem Platanoni adlocat, qui tamen locus erat in Regione xiii. Atqui Regionem xiii (id est Aventinum) proximam fuisse Porte Capene, id est Prime Regioni, in qua erat Vipsani Porticus, satis constat. Vide Martialem lib.iii.Epig.xix, ubi etiam docet Porticum hanc centum habuisse Columnas; quae Vipsane Columne vocantur eidem Epigr. quod dixi,xviii.
main_text.l: Commodiane. Vict. Ruf. Cassiodor. in Chronico, Lampridius in Commodi Vita.
Severiane. Vict. Rufus, Cassiodorus in Chron. Spartianus in Severo.

page.notes: Right column is cut off after its first lines; the rest of it is not on this part. The margin numbers 10, 20, 30, 40, 50 at the left edge are line numbers printed in the margin and are not transcribed as text. The page number is printed at top right and reads 755 (the last digit is set in an unusual form). The braces are rendered as diagram lines; the level of entries under "Templa", "Aedes", "Aedicule" and "Area" follows the grouping by braces. The left-hand part of the page is blank and the lower part is faded; the brace grouping Commodiane and Severiane under Therme is shown by levels. The two lines at lower left and the word at lower right are set apart from the column and are given as lines. Some entries near the top are faint; doubtful letters are not marked.
